newsitem.title: USA: Medtech gets American Home product rights.
newsitem.headline: Medtech gets American Home product rights.

text.p: Medtech Products Inc said on Tuesday it signed an agreement to acquire the U.S., Canadian and Puerto Rican rights to 10 over-the-counter health care brands from the Whitehall-Robins Healthcare Division of American Home Products Corp.
Medtech, which markets health and beauty aids, said the products represent about $25 million in gross sales.
The transaction is a joint effort between Medtech Laboratories Inc and Shansby Group, it said.

The deal includes rights in the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico to various AHP pain medications and medicated sprays, shampoos and sleeping aids, the company said. It also includes wart removal medication and orthopedic products.

Medtech is a privately held company headquartered in Jackson Hole, while the Shansby Group is a private equity investment partnership specializing in branded consumer products, headquartered in San Francisco.
